name: Eye of Ugin
description: The Eye of Ugin is an underground chamber on Zendikar at the center of the hedron network, which Ugin helped build and which imprisoned the Eldrazi.

description_citations.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

summary.text: The Eye of Ugin is an underground chamber on Zendikar at the center of the hedron network, which Ugin helped build and which imprisoned the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: Bolas sent Sarkhan to the Eye to watch, leaving him blinded and sleeping, and Sarkhan later took a hedron shard from it.

citations.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.
"Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

bio.text: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye.

citations.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge, and Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin there.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

bio.text: Nahiri later finds the Eye collapsed and the three titans escaped.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

status.text: As of the latest story the Eye of Ugin is collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans it held have escaped.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan recalls Bolas sending him to the Eye of Ugin to watch, and being left blinded and sleeping.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent me to the Eye. He told me to wait.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin deduces from the hedron shard that it came from the Eye after his defeat, and asks who Sarkhan is.
timeline.quote: I'm applying logic.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan explains his history: Ugin's spirit whispered to him, Bolas sent him to the Eye, and he later traveled back in time to save Ugin.
timeline.quote: When I stepped through I traveled back, before the dragons died, and tipped the scales of history.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace descends into the ruined Eye of Ugin and sees a glow ahead and the stones growing orderly.
timeline.quote: the stones around him became more orderly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A dragon unfolds from the shadows; Jace fears it is Bolas, but it introduces itself as Ugin, builder of the Eye.
timeline.quote: My name is Ugin. I helped build this place, long ago.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he knows Jace was one of three planeswalkers who opened the Eye, manipulated by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: You, a pyromancer, and a dragonspeaker. Planeswalkers all. You opened the Eye.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Ugin that Ulamog is headed for Sea Gate, and Ugin shows he does not know the city, having been away for ages.
timeline.quote: I was detained. Sea Gate?

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin tells Jace that Ulamog cannot be killed and proposes imprisoning the Eldrazi again with the help of his allies.
timeline.quote: You cannot kill Ulamog,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace and Ugin argue over whether the hedrons can be relied on again, and Ugin insists the earlier release was orchestrated.
timeline.quote: It was not an accident,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin conjures an illusion of the hedron network as it was, how it drifted without the Lithomancer, and how it stands now, shattered.
timeline.quote: The hedron network as it stands,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace counters Ugin's illusion with scenes of Sea Gate and of Zendikar's suffering people, insisting Zendikar is somebody's home.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't a puzzle to be solved,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace understands a circular glyph with three points that the leylines could be coaxed into forming.
timeline.quote: A glyph—circular, with three points at equal intervals around the circumference.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin says he is here to save the Multiverse, not the people of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: With the Eldrazi at large, the entire Multiverse is at risk.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace commits to helping, and Ugin asks him to find Sorin Markov, whom he warns not to trust, or else Nahiri.
timeline.quote: If you want to help, then seek him out, bring him here, but . . . do not trust him.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi titans dwell in the Blind Eternities and what Jace sees is a projection, so killing them would only free them.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titans do not dwell in physical space,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace privately realizes the hedrons might pull the Eldrazi fully into the physical realm so they could be killed, and keeps the idea to himself.
timeline.quote: You could pull him into the pond.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin explains that the Eldrazi brood are connected to the titans like cells or organs, so killing them achieves nothing.
timeline.quote: More like cells,

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Ugin orders Jace to dissuade his friends from attacking Ulamog and to stop them if necessary, so Ulamog is not driven from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You must dissuade your friends from attacking Ulamog directly

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace agrees but privately resolves to proceed his own way, and leaves the Eye with a plan.
timeline.quote: He had a plan. He had a destination. He was ready.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace, guided by Jori En, meets Ugin at the Eye, learns how hedrons can imprison the Eldrazi and decides to ignore Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye and made his way to Sea Gate

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the Eye of Ugin collapsed and the three Eldrazi titans escaped.
timeline.quote: But the Eye was a ruin, collapsed in on itself.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

relations.note: Ugin says he helped build it.
relations.quote: I helped build this place, long ago.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

pages_say.description: A mysterious chamber on Zendikar that is secretly the prison of the Eldrazi, damaged in the struggle of Jace, Chandra and Sarkhan.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

pages_say.description: The mysterious chamber on Zendikar where Sarkhan stood watch and the Eldrazi were released.

citation.text: "The Madness of Sarkhan" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2014.

pages_say.description: The underground chamber at the nexus of the hedron network, sealed with a lock that only three Planeswalkers can open.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

pages_say.description: The place on Tarkir from which Sarkhan's staff carries a hedron shard.

citation.text: "A New Tarkir of Old" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Dec 2014.

pages_say.description: A cavern from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard, where he heard Ugin's voice.

citation.text: "Unwritten" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2015.

pages_say.description: The tampered place on Zendikar where the Eldrazi's hedron prison was compromised, and where Ugin will join Sorin.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

pages_say.description: The Zendikar chamber from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

pages_say.description: The cavern at the center of the hedron network, built by Ugin, where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

citation.text: "Revelation at the Eye" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2015.

pages_say.description: The center of the hedron network that Jace visited.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

pages_say.description: The underground chamber at the center of the hedron network whose magic held the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

pages_say.description: The center of the hedron network where Ugin spoke to Jace.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

pages_say.description: The place on Zendikar from which Nahiri sent a signal that never reached Sorin.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

pages_say.description: The chamber in Akoum at the heart of the hedron array that contained the Eldrazi, now collapsed.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
